# Tiny

## Tiny

- [Home](https://tiny.example/)
- [About](https://tiny.example/about): One paragraph about the two people who keep this running.
- [Notes](https://tiny.example/notes): Short notes, published whenever there is something worth writing down.
- [Projects](https://tiny.example/projects): The handful of things built here that other people still use.
- [Now](https://tiny.example/now): What is taking up the time this month.
